acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition
The MS was operated in DDA mode, and full scans were acquired with a resolution of 120000 and a scan range from 450-1200 m/z, with an AGC target of 300 % and a maximum injection time of 50 ms.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were digested with 20 μg trypsin (Worthington) supplemented with 5 mM CaCl2 for 2 hours at 50 °C.

collision_energy.evidence: Most intense precursor ions were selected for fragmentation for 2 s at a normalized collision energy (NCE) of 32 %, after reaching the AGC target of 200 % or maximum injection time of 200 ms.

fractionation_method.evidence: Peptides were fractionated in eight pH fractions using strong anion exchange (flow through, pH 11, 8, 6, 5, 4, 3, and 2) and dried in vacuo.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Most intense precursor ions were selected for fragmentation for 2 s at a normalized collision energy (NCE) of 32 %, after reaching the AGC target of 200 % or maximum injection time of 200 ms.

ionization_type.evidence: Peptides were electro-sprayed directly into an Orbitrap Exploris 480 Mass Spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

ptm.evidence: Methionine oxidation and protein N-term acetylation were set as variable modifications.
Methionine oxidation and protein N-term acetylation were set as variable modifications.
